# Fractured Arcanum — Copilot Instructions

> **The canonical agent instructions for this repository live in
> [`/CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md). Read that file first and follow it in full.**

This file used to carry its own copy of the rules. Two copies drifted apart —
the file map quoted line counts that were 50–160% out of date and listed a
`PlayScreen` that no longer exists — so the content now lives in one place and
this is a pointer.

Everything in `/CLAUDE.md` applies to Copilot equally:

- **§1 Orientation** — the code index in `.github/index/`, the design docs in
  `docs/`, and the rule that the index is a map, not an authority on detail.
- **§2 Coding standards** — zero-tolerance rules, TypeScript, React, modularity,
  game engine, server, security, CSS (including the layout traps this codebase
  has actually hit), assets and audio.
- **§3 Architecture** — client and server file roles, anti-monolith guardrails,
  multiplayer protocol.
- **§4 Commands** — including which of the three layout-QA tools to reach for.
- **§5 Conventions** and **§6 Pre-commit checklist**.

If you are editing agent guidance, edit `/CLAUDE.md`. Do not re-add rules here.
